review_notes: I read the whole file and the two relevant proofs, and checked the Finset API by grep. Finset.prod_le_one exists and needs only [MulLeftMono N], which IsOrderedMonoid supplies. tprod_le_of_prod_le' is declared before tprod_le_one, so the rewrite introduces no cycle. I did not compile the rewrite. The one-liner depends on instance resolution, in particular ClosedIicTopology from OrderClosedTopology and MulLeftMono from IsOrderedMonoid. I found no further findings. one_le_tprod and tprod_nonneg have a similar case-split shape, but they need lower-bound lemmas that do not exist, so I did not propose a refactor for them.

claims.reason: Both proofs run the same case analysis. First split on Multipliable and apply HasProd.tendsto-based bounds. Then split on L.NeBot and fall back to the finprod value. Finally, in the non-multipliable case, conclude from tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable that the tprod is 1. tprod_le_of_prod_le' already proves this in generality for any a₂ with 1 ≤ a₂ and a bound on all finite products. tprod_le_one is exactly the a₂ = 1 case, with the finite-product bound supplied by Finset.prod_le_one. The non-NeBot branch of tprod_le_one re-proves that bound by hand with finprod_induction and mul_le_one'. The instances are available. OrderClosedTopology gives ClosedIicTopology for the Multipliable.tprod_le_of_prod_le step. IsOrderedMonoid gives MulLeftMono for Finset.prod_le_one. The omit on tprod_le_of_prod_le' only removes an unneeded hypothesis. Maintenance benefit: the NeBot/finprod/non-multipliable handling lives in one place, and tprod_le_one shrinks from about nine lines to one. I have not compiled the rewrite. The benefit is modest.
claims.shared_lemma: theorem tprod_le_of_prod_le' (ha₂ : 1 ≤ a₂) (h : ∀ s, ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ a₂) : ∏'[L] i, f i ≤ a₂  -- already present in the file; proof splits on Multipliable f L, then on L.NeBot, using tprod_bot / finprod_eq_prod for the non-NeBot finite-support case and tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable otherwise

theorem tprod_le_one (h : ∀ i, f i ≤ 1) : ∏'[L] i, f i ≤ 1 :=
  tprod_le_of_prod_le' le_rfl fun _ ↦ Finset.prod_le_one fun i _ ↦ h i
(Additive form, derived by to_additive) tsum_nonpos h := tsum_le_of_sum_le' le_rfl fun _ ↦ Finset.sum_nonpos fun i _ ↦ h i
